title: runlife compares `ps -o lstart` text, which depends on TZ and locale: a live run reads dead and a second run-epic can claim it
body: runlife.go:236-245 records and compares the output of ps lstart as a string. Under a different TZ or LANG (cron, launchd, a container) the same process prints a different string, so Probe says dead and Claim returns nil instead of ErrAlreadyLive. Confirmed: the same pid prints 14:19:19 locally and 12:19:19 with TZ=UTC. Read the start time in an environment-independent form (sysctl kern.proc, /proc/<pid>/stat), or pin TZ=UTC LC_ALL=C.
